summary: Iteration 59 — Project Lifecycle Re-engineering: tested backend status catalog, automations (assign→Asignado, ticket→En Gestión), manual status endpoint, {Estado_Proyecto} template variable, and frontend (status badges, stats chips, status dropdown options, Cambiar Estado modal with the 3 manual options, EmailPreviewDialog bug fix). 9/9 backend tests passing.

issues: Hydration warnings in console: <span> wrapping <tr> inside <tbody> due to the visual-editor data-ve-dynamic span. Cosmetic but produces a React error in console on every render — recommend wrapping injected spans with display:contents in a way that doesn't break tbody>tr semantics, or excluding tbody from the visual-editor instrumentation.

action_items: Optional: silence visual-editor <span> wrappers around <tr>/<tbody> to avoid console hydration noise (not a blocker).
critical_code_review_comments: EmailPreviewDialog fix (lastHtmlRef + useEffect on sourceHtml) is correct: setting innerHTML imperatively only when sourceHtml changes prevents subject edits from re-rendering the body. Verified by source review.

PUT /api/projects/{id}/status validates new_status against PROJECT_STATUSES (the full catalog of 6), not just PROJECT_MANUAL_STATUSES — that is intentional and consistent with the modal that exposes only the 3 manual options, while still allowing future system flows to set automated states. The endpoint correctly returns 400 on invalid statuses.
Assign endpoint preserves 'En Gestión' when ticket already exists (verified by code: has_ticket gate). Good.
Ticket endpoint preserves manual statuses (Suspendido/Implementado parcial/Culminado) via PROJECT_MANUAL_STATUSES gate before forcing 'En Gestión'. Good.
Projects.jsx is 948 lines — borderline against the 700-line guideline; consider extracting the Cambiar Estado modal and the stats chips block into separate components.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (UI bug fix verified via code review; status catalog, badges, stats chips, status dropdown, Cambiar Estado modal verified end-to-end via Playwright)

seed_data_creation: None. Tests reuse existing 76 migrated projects; manual status PUT reverts changes to 'En Gestión' after each parametrized run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration59_project_lifecycle.py (9 tests, all pass). Cambiar Estado modal verified via UI: exactly 3 options (Suspendido, Implementado parcial, Culminado). Status filter dropdown lists all 6 new states + 'Proceso Irregular'. Project status badges only show new catalog values (no legacy labels found). EmailPreviewDialog bug fix verified via code review (lastHtmlRef pattern). UI verification of the bug fix end-to-end requires opening the adhoc Otras Notificaciones flow with To + Subject + non-empty message (contentEditable, not textarea) — the Vista Previa button is disabled until message is non-empty. Main agent can self-verify by manually opening the dialog and editing subject.
